title: improv·artist · gestural (Cy Twombly)
mutation_directive: improv artist: gestural via Cy Twombly

improv_extras.practice: scribble as handwriting; smeared chalk on cream; eros, mythology, illegibility

v1.feedback: The palette is genuinely Twombly — graphite, dusty rose, raw umber on cream is well-observed — but the structural choice undermines the brief: Twombly's practice is scribble-as-handwriting, looping illegible marks across a field, not botanical branching. The L-system tree reads as 'pretty generative tree with muted palette' rather than gestural mark-making. A stronger execution would replace the tree skeleton with overlapping scribble loops that accumulate like palimpsest text — think horizontal sweeps with vertical drips, not branching — and use the tangent-perpendicular displacement as the primary form generator rather than a cosmetic wobble on top of a conventional structure. The particle size could also vary more dramatically by generation to mimic pressure variation in chalk strokes.

v2.feedback: Strong Twombly read — cream ground, graphite/rose/umber palette, and pressure-driven chalk sizing all land within 2 seconds. The spiral-burst clusters and vertical drip lines show the brief actually drove the code, not just a label swap. To refine: the piece is almost entirely flat (z ≈ 0) yet ships with OrbitControls — either commit to a fixed orthographic camera or give strokes real depth layering so orbit reveals chalk-over-chalk occlusion. Stroke density is too uniform across the canvas; Twombly's compositions breathe — cluster marks into 2-3 hot zones with generous negative space between, and vary stroke opacity more dramatically (some near-invisible ghost lines, some opaque smears) to sell the palimpsest illegibility the brief asks for.
